blocks.text: VMX star Angel Castro opened up about her estrangement from her mom, former actress Raven Villanueva, saying she felt abandoned despite her efforts to mend their relationship. Angel, who was formerly known as Claire Castro, spoke about their strained relationship during her guest appearance on “Fast Talk with Boy Abunda” on Wednesday, Nov. 18. During the interview, the sexy actress recalled having a “chaotic” childhood after her parents’ separation, as she spent some periods living with Villanueva and others with her father, broadcast journalist Diego Castro.
